Project Structure (All Files) ``` /vercel/sandbox/ ├── .gitignore ├── next.config.ts # Empty Next.js config ├── opencode.json # IDE/tool config (irrelevant to app) ├── package.json # Dependencies ├── package-lock.json # Lock file ├── tsconfig.json # TypeScript config ├── app/ │ ├── globals.css # Global CSS (all styles) │ ├── layout.tsx # Root layout │ ├── page.tsx # Home page (product grid) │ ├── ProductGrid.tsx # Product grid component │ ├── ProductSkeleton.tsx # Loading skeleton for grid │ └── product/ │ └── [slug]/ │ └── page.tsx # Product detail page └── lib/ └── products.ts # Product data & type definition ``` ### 2. Framework and Key Dependencies - **Framework:** **Next.js 16** (canary channel `^16.2.1-canary.45`) using the **App Router** - **React:** `19.1.0` (React 19 with Suspense support) - **React DOM:** `19.1.0` - **Dev tools:** TypeScript 5, Vitest 3.1.3, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `vite-tsconfig-paths` - **No animation libraries** (no Framer Motion, GSAP, etc.) - **No CSS framework** (no Tailwind, styled-components, etc.) - **Path alias:** `@/*` maps to `./*` (project root) ### 3. Routing Setup Uses **Next.js App Router** with file-system-based routing: | Route | File | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `/` | `app/page.tsx` | Product gallery home page | | `/product/[slug]` | `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx` | Dynamic product detail | - The `params` prop in the product detail page uses the **Next.js 15+ async pattern** (`params: Promise<{ slug: string }>`) with `await params`. - Navigation uses Next.js `` component (client-side routing). - `notFound()` from `next/navigation` is called for invalid slugs. ### 4. Component Hierarchy **Home page (`/`):** ``` (app/layout.tsx) └── (app/page.tsx - Server Component) ├──

``` ### 5. Styling Approach - **Global CSS only** — all styles are in `app/globals.css` (plain CSS, no modules, no preprocessor, no utility framework) - Key CSS classes and their styles: - `.product-grid` — CSS Grid with `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))`; `gap: 1.5rem` - `.product-card` — white background, `border-radius: 12px`, subtle box-shadow, acts as a card - `.product-image` — `aspect-ratio: 4/3`, full-width; uses `backgroundColor` inline for product color - `.product-detail` — 2-column CSS Grid (`1fr 1fr`) - `.product-hero` — `aspect-ratio: 1`, `border-radius: 12px`, uses `backgroundColor` inline - `.product-info`, `.product-price`, `.product-description` — typography styles - `.back-link` — styled "← Back to products" link - Skeleton classes: `.skeleton-image`, `.skeleton-text`, `.skeleton-text.short`, `.skeleton-text.large` - No CSS Modules, no Tailwind, no styled-components, no CSS-in-JS. ### 6. Existing Animation / Transition Code - **Only one animation exists:** a CSS `@keyframes pulse` animation used for skeleton loading states: ```css @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } } ``` Applied to `.skeleton-image` and `.skeleton-text` via `animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite`. - **No page transition animations** (no `framer-motion`, no View Transitions API, no CSS transitions on route changes). - **No layout animations** (grid items don't animate on mount/unmount). - **No hover/focus micro-interactions** defined in CSS. ### 7. Data Fetching Patterns - **Static, in-memory data** — all product data lives in `lib/products.ts` as a hardcoded array of 4 products. - **Simulated async delay** — the `ProductDetails` server component artificially delays with `await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))` to demonstrate Suspense loading behavior. - **React Suspense boundaries** are used in two places: 1. **Home page:** `}>` wrapping `` 2. **Product detail page:** `}>` wrapping `` - All components are **Server Components** (no `"use client"` directive anywhere). There are no client components in the project. - No data fetching libraries (no SWR, no React Query, no fetch calls). - The `getProduct(slug)` function is a simple `Array.find()` lookup. ### 8. Key Architectural Notes - The product color field is used as `backgroundColor` for product "images" (no actual images — just colored rectangles). - There is **no state management** (no Redux, Zustand, Context, etc.). - There is **no API layer** — no `route.ts` handlers, no external data fetching. - The app is minimal: 4 products, 2 routes, 5 component files, 1 CSS file, 1 data file. - **No tests** exist yet despite Vitest being a dev dependency. - **No image optimization** or `` component usage; product visuals are solid-color divs. session_id: ses_26821fef8ffefgHXF2Z4kmNpXe
